questions.prompt: In LangGraph, nodes perform work and edges define transitions between nodes.
questions.explanation: Nodes represent computation, while edges determine how execution moves through the graph.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of a checkpointer in LangGraph?

options.text: Persist graph state across execution steps or sessions

questions.explanation: A checkpointer saves graph state, enabling resumable workflows and features such as memory across turns.

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes Google ADK?

options.text: A framework for building AI agents and multi-agent applications

questions.explanation: Google ADK is a framework for developing AI agents and multi-agent applications.

questions.prompt: An agent built with Google ADK can use tools to interact with external systems.
questions.explanation: ADK agents can be equipped with tools that let them perform tasks and interact with systems beyond text generation.
